column1: # The reference and comparison stages across eleven runs spanning a host load
# average of 7.4 to 17.4, with the load and GPU utilization each run saw. Two
# further runs at load 24 are cited in README.md and were not captured here.
# reference_ms varies between 77.3 and 88.6 ms for reasons these instruments do
# not reach. Host load is not one: the correlation is -0.11 once the load-7.5
# batch below is set aside, and clock-samples.tsv shows the package at the same
# frequency at load 4 as at load 15. The share the reference takes of the two
# stages is what holds, at 95.47 percent with a standard deviation of 0.44.
# The setup stages in these runs are contaminated by the same load and are not
# retained; cuda_context_ms travels as the witness, spanning 132 to 2347 ms here.
